blocks.text: Murrayville homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Murrayville, September 2026. Detached houses: 30 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 17% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 35 listed at month end and 8 sold in September, a sales ratio of 23% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 17 over 4 months against an average of 25.0 listed, about 5.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 5 sold. condos and townhomes sold 26 over 4 months against an average of 31.0 listed, about 4.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 8 sold.
